shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.narration_text: बीस साल से कुआँ पत्थर से बंद था। आज आवाज़ उसके ढक्कन के ऊपर से आई।
shots.first_frame_description: Rekha enters the edge of an empty courtyard holding a small round brass lota, an Indian water vessel, sealed lid fully visible.
shots.visual_action: She stops and looks toward the top of the lid.

shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.narration_text: रेखा ने लोटा रखा। पानी अपने आप पत्थर की दरार में खिंचने लगा।
shots.first_frame_description: Rekha’s hand holds a full brass cup a finger-width above the lid beside the rim seam.
shots.visual_action: She sets it down. A thin water thread climbs over its lip and runs into the seam.
shots.effects: One distinct thread of water, no moving lid

shots.speaker: @CHAR-02-SITA
shots.devanagari_dialogue: ढक्कन पर रखो। नीचे वो अभी भी पहरा देता है।
shots.first_frame_description: Sita sits at the rim with her face and warning hand visible.
shots.visual_action: She says the line once, glances at the seam and draws back her fingers.
shots.effects: A drip falls past her wrist

shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.narration_text: रेखा ने लोटा सरकाकर बीच में कर दिया। पानी वहीं थम गया।
shots.first_frame_description: Brass cup by the rim, Rekha’s hand poised behind it, flat centre visible.
shots.visual_action: She slides the cup toward the centre; the trickle breaks at once.

shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.narration_text: तभी लोटे के पानी से भारी आवाज़ उठी। अब पहरेदार को भी पिला दो।
shots.first_frame_description: Close view of the cup in Rekha’s hand at waist height, surface flat.
shots.visual_action: Ripples spread from the centre. Rekha’s hand freezes; cut on the widening rings.
shots.effects: Three small concentric ripples from within cup
shots.sound_design: Low water vibration; narrator performs the quoted words separately

shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.narration_text: मीना ने चाबी घुमाई। ताला बाहर था, लेकिन चाबी किसी ने अंदर से खींच ली।
shots.first_frame_description: Meena’s fingers on a plain brass key seated in the outside lock.
shots.visual_action: She turns once. The key slides inward and out of sight. Her fingers close on air.
shots.effects: Chipped paint and lock stay fixed

shots.speaker: @CHAR-02-HARI
shots.devanagari_dialogue: बेटी, उसे मत उतारना। मैं भी यही भूल कर बैठा था।
shots.first_frame_description: Hari in three-quarter profile under the hall lamp, looking toward the open doorway.
shots.visual_action: He delivers the line once, visibly anxious, then closes his mouth.
shots.effects: Soft rain behind the hall window

shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.narration_text: मीना की उँगलियाँ चाबी पर थीं। उसने पलटकर देखा, और दरवाज़ा बंद हो गया।
shots.first_frame_description: Meena’s fingers hold the key against the hook, blue door still ajar.
shots.visual_action: Her fingers lift the key as she looks back. The door swings fully shut.
shots.camera: Medium close, key and door visible
shots.effects: Door closes once; shadows remain consistent
shots.sound_design: Small click followed by wood thud

shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.narration_text: अब वहाँ दरवाज़ा नहीं था। बस नीले रंग का चौकोर निशान था।
shots.first_frame_description: Meena faces a solid wall with a blue rectangular stain where the door stood.
shots.visual_action: She runs her free hand across the wall and finds no gap.

shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.narration_text: फिर उसके बैग की जेब में पीतल खनका। कमरे ने चाबी फिर भेज दी थी।
shots.first_frame_description: Close on zipped outer pocket of Meena’s canvas bag, hand hovering above it.
shots.visual_action: A key-shaped weight drops inside the fabric from nowhere. Meena pulls her hand back. Cut.
shots.sound_design: One recognizable brass clink, then quiet
